purpose: 5-minute onset discovery and frozen later-period replication; no modification to earlier experiments
universe: Same36 fixed coins, cached Bybit spot daily trade aggregates Mar31..Oct1, hourly candles throughOct8. Prior outcomes already used, not a pristine holdout.
onset: t is start of a5min candle whose close is>=1.02*close(t); maximum high next60min>=1.08*close(t). Past30min each5min close return<1% and cumulative30min return<2%. Require known source files for all next12bins and actual trade in breakout bin. Earliest qualifying event then24h refractory per coin. No posthoc trough picking.
eligibility: Known past30days continuous hourly candles and daily turnover200k..20M using last closed hour only; quiet30min gate as above. Past6h source files complete,>=80% active5min bins, current bin traded, lasttrade<=5min old, latest6 completed hourly trade/candle turnover sums within1%. All6 features finite. Missing files never treated as zero volume.
features: Last15min versus baseline prior5h ending60min before each timestamp: log quote-volume ratio, log trade-count ratio, log average trade-notional ratio, net-buy fraction difference, log normalized15min high-low-range ratio (baseline mean rolling15min range). Price acceleration=last15min return minus previous45min return/3. Include RPI and assume archive side=taker convention. Only information at or before signal timestamp.
trajectories: Offsets -60,-30,-15,-5,0 minutes. Match3 same-time controls with next60min peak<8%, eligible/quality gates. Match by liquidity,7dayvolatility,24hreturn observed60min before anchor, discovery-only SD, maxdistance3. All4 trajectories complete; drop whole set otherwise.
split: Discovery Apr2..Jun30 with120min label purge beforeJul1. Replication Aug1..Sep30 23:55UTC with future raw data throughOct1. July unused.
selection: Discovery inferred direction for each6 features; at most2 selected if n>=10, oriented matched concordance>=0.60 and95%7day-block-bootstrap lower>0.50. At most1 of quote/count family. Rank by concordance. Threshold90th percentile of oriented feature across all eligible discovery5min timestamps. Freeze code+protocol+dependencies+rules before replication results. No forced selection if none qualify.
replay: Selected feature rules individually plus AND if2; every eligible5min timestamp, max3 alerts/day,24h coin cooldown, simultaneous rank by score then symbol. Hit if objective onset begins within0..60min; separately strict5..60min lead and next5min execution sensitivity. Same-time/count1000 random replays with24h cooldown; report missing slots, event recall,60min adverse excursion. No PnL claim.
statistics: 10000 fixed7day-block bootstrap draws; descriptive discovery95% and replication99.1667% intervals for6 features. Graphs show paired-set medians, not certainty bands. Weak or rare observations are not proof of no signal. No post-result parameter tuning.
